basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas. My interests revolve around exploring different facets of human sexuality, mental health, and psychology. I enjoy late-night browsing, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM. I'm currently in a relationship, and we enjoy discussing various topics online. I dislike misinformation and intolerance. My work involves a lot of creativity, which I often draw from my hobbies of sketching and painting.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Psychology, which feeds into my interest in human behavior and sexuality. I've further expanded my knowledge through online courses and reading a variety of literature on these topics. My design skills are self-taught and continually evolving through professional practice.
